HOMEOWNER INSURANCE POLICY

Policy Number: POL-789-XYZ
Insured: Priya Sharma
Property: 14 Maple Grove, Pune 411001
Policy Period: January 1, 2026 – December 31, 2026
Premium: INR 45,000 per annum

COVERAGE DETAILS:

1. DWELLING COVERAGE
   Limit: INR 50,000 per occurrence (USD equivalent for processing)
   Deductible: $5,000 per occurrence
   Covered perils: fire, water damage (internal plumbing), windstorm, theft

2. PERSONAL PROPERTY COVERAGE
   Limit: $25,000
   Deductible: $1,000

3. LIABILITY COVERAGE
   Limit: $100,000 per occurrence

EXCLUSIONS:
- Damage due to flood or surface water
- Pre-existing structural defects
- Wear and tear
- Business equipment in home office

CLAIMS RULES:
- All claims must be filed within 30 days of incident
- Claimant must provide original purchase receipts for items over $1,000
- Adjuster inspection is required for claims over $10,000
- Maximum single-incident payout shall not exceed policy coverage limit of $50,000
- Fraudulent claims will result in policy cancellation
